item: Self-rendered street view at high zoom (row 175, 0.7 row B session part)
summary: Q821 = b: below a view 0.2 degrees wide the map asks /api/osm/view?layer=streets and draws the ingested roads itself on the existing Canvas 2D layer, by class, with named major roads; never a tile server, external host or WebGL. Q822 caps hold: over 8,000 roads or 60,000 vertices whole classes are left out in the pinned STREET_CLASSES order (paths first, motorways last) and named; the top class alone over a cap falls back to the clusters. An area with no roads says so. The legend gives each country's extract date and last applied diff, never 'current'; the OSM credit stays visible. Strings x12. Chromium-checked en/ar/ja on a 37,020-road synthetic grid.
